source.description: Golden-master values captured from the legacy FMD ODE page (fmd_simulation.php) running in headless Chrome. Regenerate with tools/capture-fmd-legacy-fixtures.mjs.

displayed.vsaveSummary: With ~381,990 cattle vaccinated (α_C = 0.090/day plus existing vaccinated stock), the model predicts 3,283 cattle protected from FMD infection and 385 deaths averted over 49 days, out of 10,164 infections expected without vaccination.
